title: Code for: Uncovering the Basis of Human Connectome Complexity: The Role of Neuronal Morphology
description:
Code and analysis accompanying the paper Uncovering the Basis of Human Connectome Complexity: The Role of Neuronal Morphology (Barros-Zulaica et al., 2026).

The repository contains the code used to analyze how neuronal morphology influences the complexity of predicted synaptic connectomes in human and rodent cortical microcircuits: generation and pruning of human and rat connectivity matrices (matrix_generation_extraction), connectivity and higher-order complexity analyses with the notebooks that reproduce the main and supplementary figures (connectivity_matrix_analysis), and morphology analyses (morphology_data_analysis).

Large datasets (connectivity matrices and reconstructed neuronal morphologies) are archived separately on Zenodo: https://zenodo.org/records/21216278
